settings.prompt: Fixed camera underwater scene. The camera and cave remain absolutely still. Only the long fine ivory hanging baleen strands gently sway in a slow underwater current, with their upper roots firmly attached to the stationary cave roof. Slight flowing waves travel down the strands, the flexible tips drift a small distance sideways and gently return. Delicate asynchronous natural underwater movement. Preserve the hand painted illustration, original colors, architecture and silhouette. Slow serene atmospheric environmental animation.
settings.negative: camera movement, zoom, pan, changing scenery, morphing rocks, moving bridge, collapsing cave, violent wind, fast motion, melting, distorted forms, new objects, color shift, glitches, stripes, text
